title: Will never buy again
text: Will never buy again. Ordered two nightstands. Both arrived damaged. One of okay enough to use until I found new ones but 1 week in the whole front of the drawer came off. I got my money back but it’s a huge hassle to try and get rid of these damaged pieces as they don’t come apart. Waste of time.
